decisions.reason: Temporary site welfare setup and removal; no purchase of a new sanitary container is specified.
Operation, maintenance, heating and cleaning of the sanitary container are services.
The position covers laying and removing a temporary DN 100 drainage line, without requiring new pipe supply.
The contractor must make a new pipe connection to the existing sewer branch and include the physical connection in the price.

items.material_name: DN 100 wastewater connection to existing DN 150 sewer branch
items.description: Pipe connection for sanitary container drainage into the existing sewer branch.
